lesson.text: Quick memory: what do builders wear on a building site? (A hard hat and gloves.) Today: building a little wall.
Builders stick blocks together with mortar: cement, sand and water mixed into a soft paste. A trowel spreads it.
Every row must be level: flat, not sloping. A spirit level shows it: its bubble sits in the middle.
Builders stagger the joints: each block sits across two below, like a jigsaw. A wall with its joints in one straight line can split.
Real building sites can be dangerous: only go on one with permission and a grown-up. You can look at walls from the pavement.
Try it in the world: open Real Builder and build your little wall. Next: a garden shed, on the Middle track.

exercises.prompt: What do builders spread between blocks?
A hard hat keeps your head safe on a building site.
exercises.explain: True: on a building site the hard hat stays on.
A trowel spreads the mortar and taps blocks down.

exercises.prompt: A spirit level's bubble sits in the middle when a row is level.
exercises.explain: True: the bubble in the middle means level.

exercises.prompt: How should the second row start?
choices: with a whole block right over the joint
exercises.explain: A half block moves the joints along, so each block sits across two below.

exercises.prompt: A wall has 3 rows of 3 blocks. How many blocks is that?
A wall with all its joints in one straight line is strong.
exercises.explain: False: it can split along the straight line. Stagger the joints.
You wear the hard hat and the gloves; you build with the trowel and the blocks.

exercises.prompt: One big block is as long as 2 bricks. How many bricks long is a row of 3 blocks?
Why do builders check every row with a spirit level?
choices: so the wall goes up straight and flat
exercises.hint: What happens to a sloping row?
exercises.explain: A level row keeps the wall straight as it goes up.

exercises.prompt: Building a row: put it in order.
items: check it with the spirit level
exercises.explain: Spread the mortar, lay the blocks, then check them with the spirit level.
